facts.text: The hotel sits atop the Landmark72 Tower in Hanoi's new Central Business District.
facts.excerpt: Situated at the heart of Hanoi's new Central Business District, InterContinental Hanoi Landmark72 is the highest luxury hotel in Hanoi, atop the iconic Landmark72 Tower.

facts.text: The hotel is the highest luxury hotel in Hanoi.
facts.excerpt: InterContinental Hanoi Landmark72 is the highest luxury hotel in Hanoi, atop the iconic Landmark72 Tower.

facts.text: All rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic views of Hanoi.
facts.excerpt: With floor-to-ceiling windows, all rooms and suites offer panoramic views of Hanoi.

facts.text: Rooms have a deep-soak bathtub and a walk-in rain shower.
facts.excerpt: Relax in a deep-soak bathtub, or rejuvenate in your walk-in rain shower, with premium amenities.

facts.text: The Club InterContinental Lounge is on the 71st floor and is the largest in Southeast Asia.
facts.excerpt: our exclusive Club InterContinental Lounge on the 71st floor, the largest in Southeast Asia.

facts.text: Club Lounge access is for guests booking Club InterContinental rooms and suites, and InterContinental Royal Ambassadors.
facts.excerpt: Lounge access is reserved for guests booking Club InterContinental rooms, suites, and InterContinental Royal Ambassadors.

facts.text: The outdoor pool looks out over the city skyline.
facts.excerpt: Treat yourself to the experience of immersing in the swimming pool looking out over the city skyline.

facts.text: The pool is on the 7th floor of the building.
facts.excerpt: The hotel's pool is located on the 7th floor of the building, providing an exclusive and serene escape from the hustle and bustle of the city.

facts.text: Guests have access to yoga and Zumba classes, table tennis, indoor mini golf, a sauna and a hot tub on the 7th floor.
facts.excerpt: Hotel guests also enjoy access to the Fitness Centre, Yoga & Zumba Classes, Table Tennis, Indoor Mini Golf, Sauna & Hot Tub on the 7th floor.

facts.text: In-house guests have access to a 24-hour, fully equipped gym on the 71st floor.
facts.excerpt: In-house guests can enjoy access to a 24-hour, fully equipped gym located on the 71st floor of the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel's five restaurants and bars are on the 62nd floor of the Landmark72 building.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 62nd floor of the Landmark72 building, InterContinental Hanoi Landmark72 offers a wide variety of exquisite dining experiences in its five restaurants and bars.

facts.text: Q Bar is a speakeasy-style cocktail bar inspired by the O Quy Ho Pass in northern Vietnam.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the beauty of O Quy Ho Pass in Northern Vietnam, Q Bar is the best sleek speakeasy bar in Hanoi offering innovative and selective cocktails

facts.text: Stellar Steakhouse blends old Hollywood glamour with contemporary style.
facts.excerpt: Stellar Steakhouse redefines luxury dining with an elegant blend of old Hollywood glamour and contemporary style.

facts.text: Part of The Hive Lounge has grand beehive-inspired architecture, and the other part overlooks the Hanoi skyline.
facts.excerpt: There are two parts to the lounge, one with comfortable sofa seating immersed in natural lights and overlooking the Hanoi skyline; the other captivated by a grand beehive-inspired architecture.

facts.text: The concierge can arrange trips to Ha Long Bay and Van Long Wetland Nature Reserve.
facts.excerpt: We can also arrange trips to world-famous sights including Ha Long Bay and Van Long Wetland Nature Reserve.

facts.text: Complimentary parking is available for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary parking is available at InterContinental Hanoi Landmark72 for hotel guests.

facts.text: The Vietnam Museum of Ethnology is about 4 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Vietnam Museum of Ethnology - 2.49 miles away (4 kilometers)

facts.text: Noi Bai International Airport is about 25 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: approximately 15.53 miles away (25 kilometers) from the hotel

facts.excerpt: Celebrate family get-togethers with fun-filled activities for the little ones such as cookie decorating, balloon twisting and colouring.
